Usage: url [options]

Cross-platform URL encode/decode/parse/build/join/query-edit.

Options:
  --form        Shorthand for --mode form (applies to encode/decode)
  --raw         Disable normalisation on build/join/query set/delete
  --strict      (decode only) reject malformed percent-escapes (default: pass through)
  --all         (query get only) print every value for the key, one per line
  --mode MODE   Encoding variant: component (default), path, query, form
  --field NAME  (parse only) emit a single field; conflicts with --json
  --scheme S    (build only) URL scheme; defaults to https
  --host H      (build only) hostname — required
  --port N      (build only) port number
  --path P      (build only) URL path
  --fragment F  (build only) fragment
  --query K=V   (build only) query pair; repeatable (repeatable)
  -h, --help    Show help
  --version     Show version
  --color       Force colored output
  --no-color    Disable colored output
  --json        JSON output
  --describe    Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

Exit Codes:
  0    Success
  125  Usage error: bad flags, unknown subcommand, base URL must be absolute
  126  Runtime error: invalid URL, key not found
